text:
zoe: quick heads-up 12 - the new qbringup (q4b-longform-compact) is causing de-dup instability for deid-heavy long prompts. seeing tokenization differences leading to different fingerprint buckets.

harry: can you point to a minimal repro? sample ids?

zoe: repro set attached, but example id 37a9f shows two different fingerprint hashes across kernels. token counts identical but whitespace normalization differs.

mina: is this tokenizer model-side or our ingest normalizer? I ran a diff and it's the normalizer trimming trailing newlines differently after quant kernel switch.

ravi: that aligns with the qbringup change where we enabled packed-kernel trimming optim.

zoe: impact: near-duplicates bypassed dedupe and entered golden candidate picks; label-ops reported increased churn and inconsistent instructions.

label-ops: we got a noisy batch this morning. annotators saw same doc twice with slightly different deid redaction prompts and disagreed. throughput down ~18%. pausing new longform assignments.

harry: mitigation options: 1) revert normalizer tweak on canary 2) re-run normalizer+fingerprint for the 6h window 3) compute embeds and run an embed-dedupe for longform only.

mina: cheapest immediate is option 2. I have a script:
```
./tools/normalize_and_hash.sh --seedbank longform-canary --window 1789950000-1789999990 --hash-version stable
```
Dry-run shows 142 affected candidates.

ravi: if we re-normalize, remember to include original instruction ids in pairing manifest so label-ops doesn't relabel.

label-ops: yes please include instruction_id and original_manifest refs. we'll hold until manifest posted.

harry: I'll add an automated check in the qbringup pipeline to compare digest shapes between new kernel and stable for a fixed longform seed set; fail if mismatch > 0.4%. filing INF-4010.

mina: I'll run the re-normalize/apply now and post manifest path when done.

ingest-bot: deploy: qbringup-normalizer-patch -> succeeded

mina: re-normalize complete. 142 candidates rehashed, manifest: manifests/longform_normalize_1789999990.json. reassigned 37 items to label-ops pool.

label-ops: ack received. pausing lifted once we confirm golden rescore. please run a 100-sample golden check.

zoe: golden rescore 100 samples = 92/100 agreement (baseline 95/100). big improvement from broken run (79/100). logging artifacts in runboard.

harry: follow-ups: add normalization compatibility gate to onboarding checklist, add embed-dedupe prototype for longform (INF-4011), and ensure pairing manifests carry instruction provenance.

label-ops: will coordinate relabelling windows if needed. thanks team. :thumbsup:

zoe: closing - ingest resumed with stable normalizer fallback for longform for next 24h. will monitor.
